acceptanceCriteria: Setters declared in export_test.go are recognised as hook users.
A fixture package covers it; the test fails before the fix.
body: Residual from lane perf-1022s (PR beamfall/corvint#1552, seal aaa260d44). The analysis that decides which tests touch shared test hooks (used to pick tests safe for t.Parallel) does not see hook setters exported through export_test.go, so it can misclassify tests.
title: Test-hook analysis misses setters exported from export_test.go
